title: Design System: Assess · Mesa de luz

label.purpose: Tracked condensed caps for every field name, state and action.

clock.purpose: Time remaining, always in a fixed cell.

code.purpose: Code panels and code answers; ligatures off.

motion.name: ease-sheet
motion.purpose: Sheet slide on next/previous: mass with a slight overshoot (280ms).

components.name: Answer Field
components.description: Short answer; magenta border once it holds your answer.

components.name: Option Row (selected)
components.description: Ruled answer row; selection is hatched magenta and named.
components.css: .ds-opt{display:grid;grid-template-columns:62px 1fr auto;align-items:center;min-height:56px;padding:0 24px;border-bottom:1px solid #cdcbc5;background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(236,42,138,.3) 0 1.5px,transparent 1.5px 7px),rgba(236,42,138,.07)}.ds-key{width:36px;height:36px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#ec2a8a;color:#fff;font:800 21px/1 'Sofia Sans Extra Condensed',sans-serif}.ds-opt code{font:400 18px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-variant-ligatures:none}.ds-mark{font:700 13px/1 'Sofia Sans Extra Condensed',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#a30e58}

components.name: Rail Row
components.description: Question list row with tone swatch; current row hatched magenta.

components.name: Submit Block
components.description: Isolated ink block, never adjacent to navigation.

components.name: Timer Cell (≤5 min)
components.description: Escalation inverts to ink; never red.
components.css: .ds-timer{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;padding:12px 18px;min-width:190px;background:#141414;color:#f8f7f4}.ds-timer span{font:700 13px/1.2 'Sofia Sans Extra Condensed',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#c9c7c1}.ds-timer b{font:800 46px/.85 'Sofia Sans Extra Condensed',sans-serif}

narrative.northStar: Mesa de luz — the exam as a stack of exposure-record sheets
narrative.overview: Neutral zones carry all structure; one dichroic magenta marks only what belongs to the student. Light is the light table, dark is the darkroom. Escalation inverts to ink instead of turning red.
keyCharacteristics: Square sheets with one soft shadow
Tracked condensed caps for labels and numerals

rules.name: The Yours-Only Rule
rules.body: Magenta marks only the student's answer, position, focus and granted time.

rules.name: The Reversed-Plate Rule
rules.body: Warnings, penalties and annulment invert to ink; no red or amber.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No small label above a heading or big numeral.

rules.name: The Straight-Top Rule
rules.body: Only sheets beneath tilt; the reading sheet is square.

dos: Keep counters in fixed cells with tabular numerals
Show figures on a light print matte in both themes
Explain every penalty and that the teacher can revert it
donts: Don't use red or amber for warnings
Don't round corners or use option cards
